content: QuPath measurement compartments for cell classifiers: measurements follow the pattern '[Compartment]: [ChannelName] [stat]' — e.g., 'Nucleus: DAPI mean', 'Cytoplasm: TdTomato-AF568 mean', 'Cell: Fos-AF488 mean'. Cytoplasm measurements only exist if cell expansion is enabled in detection. If a classifier references 'Cytoplasm: X mean' but cell expansion was zero or the channel name does not exactly match, the measurement column will be missing and classification will silently fail or misclassify all cells. Channel names in the classifier JSON must exactly match channel names in the OME-TIFF metadata as QuPath reads them — a mismatch produces no error but classifies on the wrong or missing column.
